opening.argument: The program requires an upfront Bitcoin payment to secure a binary position, while obtaining a referral link requires both that payment and at least one additional unit in a pool. The speaker expressly states that “$99 in Bitcoin will lock in your binary spot” and describes commissions paid when referred people make purchases. The structure therefore ties prospective earnings to further purchases and recruitment. It also promotes a founders’ pool in which “one percent of the coins mind will be split amongst the five hundred positions,” while presenting daily earnings as an example rather than a realized payout. The speaker says a participant is “earning nine dollars a day” and conditionally projects about $270 over 30 days, but the evidence describes prospective pool shares and referral commissions, not demonstrated returns.

citations.quote: $99 in Bitcoin will lock in your binary spot
in order to get a referral link, so that you can referral others, you're going to need to purchase at least one unit.
one percent of the coins mind will be split amongst the five hundred positions
And if you earn that as an average over 30-day stretch, let's call that a month, you earn about an extra 270 U.S. dollars denominated in Bitcoin.
